title: Improved readability in the assistant
summary: We did a whole visual overhaul on Frigade Assistant's responses. We're talking typography pass, spacing pass, mobile pass, everything. The chat panel, the guide card, and mobile web share new type siz
body_markdown:
We did a whole visual overhaul on Frigade Assistant's responses. We're talking typography pass, spacing pass, mobile pass, everything. The chat panel, the guide card, and mobile web share new type sizes, spacing, and list styling, so long answers with steps, bold labels, and code are easier to scan.


We also fixed and updated numerous animations as well as took a pass at our underlying model to make understanding the assistant's responses easier for your users. Answers should now be shorter and more concise. Everything should be easier to read.
